$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

sfx.description: The sound-effects bus: responses, bumps, gags.

voice.description: The voice bus: the baby, Mama.

buses.description: Volume of each bus: the mix. The player volumes of story 2.8 multiply it.

patternMs.description: `navigator.vibrate` pattern, in ms: vibrate, pause, vibrate, pause...

light.description: A light tap: a tick, a bump.

patternMs.description: `navigator.vibrate` pattern, in ms: vibrate, pause, vibrate, pause...
`navigator.vibrate` pattern, in ms: vibrate, pause, vibrate, pause...
`navigator.vibrate` pattern, in ms: vibrate, pause, vibrate, pause...

heartbeat.description: A lub-dub: Fatherly Instinct kicks in (story 2.9).

patternMs.description: `navigator.vibrate` pattern, in ms: vibrate, pause, vibrate, pause...

fanfare.description: A run of pulses on the fireworks' rhythm: the level's finale (story 7.4).

haptics.description: The vibration of each kind. A browser without vibration ignores them.

gainPct.description: Loop volume on its bus, in percent.

fadeMs.description: Fade in when the loop starts and fade out when it stops, in ms.

babble.description: The baby babbles while `baby.babbling` (its stop is the silence).

calm.description: The calm stem: the music at rest.

tense.description: The tense stem: it comes up while a threat is on (story 2.6).

stems.description: Two synchronized stems of the same length, started together and looped.

gainPct.description: Music volume on its bus, in percent.

fadeMs.description: Fade in when the music starts and fade out when it stops or is cut, in ms.

music.description: The level music: two synchronized stems mixed by the game state.

gainPct.description: Loop volume on its bus, in percent.

fadeMs.description: Fade in when the loop starts and fade out when it stops, in ms.

additionalProperties.description: A sound that loops while a state lasts.

sequenceMusic.description: The music of each special sequence (story 4.4), by id, named by a sequence def `framing.musicLoop`: while one plays, the level stems are stopped.

loops.description: Sounds driven by a state, not by an event: they are not cues.

notes.description: The notes, one per judged beat: the note of judged beat `n` is `notes[n % notes.length]`.

countIn.description: The tick of the count-in beats.

decoy.description: The sound of a decoy, between two beats.

gainPct.description: Volume of the track on its bus, in percent.

additionalProperties.description: The sounds of one rhythm track.

beatTracks.description: The rhythm tracks (story 4.5), by id, named by a `beats` step. The notes are planned one by one on the audio clock, not looped.

scheduleAheadMs.description: How far ahead of the audio clock a note is planned, in real ms. A note late by more than this is dropped.

replanToleranceMs.description: A planned note whose time moved by more than this, in real ms, is cancelled and planned again (slow-mo, hitstop, a debug time scale).

beatScheduler.description: How the client plans the notes on the audio clock (story 4.5). Real time.

approachMs.description: How long before a beat its ring starts closing on Papa, in sim ms.

beatRing.description: The ring that closes on Papa at each beat (story 4.5). Sim time: a pause holds it.

rowCountUpMs.description: How long one score row counts up from 0 to its total, in real ms.

rowStaggerMs.description: Delay between the start of one score row and the next, in real ms.

starsDelayMs.description: Pause between the last row landing and the first star, in real ms.

starIntervalMs.description: Delay between two stamped stars, in real ms.

actionsDelayMs.description: Pause between the last star (or the last row, with no star) and the buttons, in real ms.

inputGraceMs.description: After the screen comes up, and again after the buttons come up, presses that start within this many real ms skip nothing and press nothing, so that taps still mashing for the last parry do not skip the note or hit « Rejouer »; 0 turns it off.

photoHoldMs.description: How long the end photo stays alone on screen, after it drops in and before the rows start, in real ms (story 3.6); 0 goes straight to the rows. A level that took no photo skips it. A press skips it.

reactionHoldMs.description: How long each of Mama's reactions (her laugh, sigh or scream, with her line) stays on screen after the photo and before the rows start, in real ms (story 3.7); 0 goes straight on. A press skips them all.

resultScreen.description: The sequence of the Result screen (story 1.22): the photo (story 3.6), the reactions of Mama (story 3.7), then rows, then stars, then buttons. Real time: the sim never reads it.

gainPct.description: Cue volume on its bus, in percent.

beep.description: The beep of the audio phase. Not a cue: the ring and the flash are the visual measure, and calibration has no vibration (EXPERIENCE.md).

calibration.description: The sounds of the latency calibration (story 2.7).

slideMs.description: How long the sequence bar stays mounted after the end, to slide out, in real ms. Real time: not read from `transitionend`, which never fires under reduced motion.

sequenceBar.description: The sequence bar under the timer (story 4.4). Real time: the sim never reads it.

cashInHoldMs.description: How long the combo badge shows the points of a cash-in (« +N »), in real ms, even though the multiplier is already back to its minimum.

comboBadge.description: The combo badge above Papa (story 4.2). Real time: the sim never reads it.

holdMs.description: How long the hint above Papa (« POSE-LE D'ABORD ! » after a refused toilet) stays up, in real ms. A second refusal restarts it.

papaHint.description: The hint above Papa (story 4.3). Real time: the sim never reads it.

laidHeightM.description: The height of the baby's centre above the floor once laid on the mattress, in metres. While a Firmness judged on its release runs, the carried baby is lowered linearly from Papa's chest to this height, from the telegraph to the final pose (story 4.8).

bombDrop.description: The bomb drop on screen (story 4.8). Read per frame on the sim clock; the sim never reads it.

event.description: The sim event that starts it.

amountPct.description: How much his height changes at the peak of the curve, in percent: below 0 he squashes first and then stretches, above 0 the other way round. His width follows so that his volume holds. The bounds keep his height strictly positive.

durationMs.description: How long it lasts, in sim ms.

items.description: One squash and stretch: one event on one character.

squash.description: Which events squash and stretch whom.

clip.description: The looping clip of a walk or a crawl, as named in the `.glb`.

speedMps.description: The floor speed at which this clip plays at its own pace, in m/s: its feet do not slide at that speed. Faster or slower, it plays in proportion.

items.description: The natural speed of one travelling clip.

clipSpeeds.description: The natural speed of the travelling clips.

clip.description: A clip of Papa's, as named in the `.glb`.

facing.description: Where his body turns while the player sees this clip: `camera` faces the screen, `awayFromBaby` turns his back to the baby. The sim's heading is untouched.

items.description: Where Papa faces while one clip plays.

papaClipFacing.description: Which clips turn Papa toward the camera or away from the baby (story 2.13).

steamSwayDeg.description: How far the coffee steam leans to each side, in degrees.

steamStretchPct.description: How much the steam grows and shrinks in height, in percent.

steamPeriodMs.description: How long a full sway of the steam lasts, in sim ms. Never under the 3 Hz flash cap.

blablaTiltDeg.description: How far the bla-bla bubble tilts to each side, in degrees.

blablaBobAmplitudeM.description: How far the bla-bla bubble bobs up and down, in metres.

blablaPeriodMs.description: How long a full wobble of the bla-bla bubble lasts, in sim ms. Never under the 3 Hz flash cap.

screenOffsetM.description: How far from Papa the bla-bla bubble stands across the screen, in metres: above 0 toward the right of the screen, below 0 toward the left.

heightM.description: How high above the floor the foot of the bla-bla bubble stands, in metres.

blablaPlace.description: Where the bla-bla bubble stands at Papa's side, clear of the activity bubble.

busyProps.description: The side effects of Papa's busy props (story 2.13): the steam of his mug and the bla-bla of his phone. Sim clock; held still under reduced motion.

characters.description: The animated characters (story 7.2): squash, clip speeds, facings, busy props. Read by the views on the sim clock; the sim never reads it. Their fades and turn are `feel.json › characters` (story 7.8).

openMs.description: How long the door takes to swing open once the final rush starts, in sim ms (story 3.5). Read on the render sim clock, so a pause or a slow-mo holds it.

openAngleDeg.description: How far the door panel swings open, in degrees (the panel is centred on the door anchor and hinged at one end).

widthM.description: The door panel's width, in metres.

heightM.description: The door panel's height, in metres.

thicknessM.description: The door panel's thickness, in metres.

door.description: The door on screen (story 3.5): a closed panel at the level's `ANCHOR_door` that swings open from the start of the final rush. Read per frame on the sim clock; the sim never reads it.

widthPx.description: Width of the end photo canvas, in pixels (story 3.6). Its CSS size is the polaroid’s.

heightPx.description: Height of the end photo canvas, in pixels. The camera frames the room at this aspect.

tiltMaxDeg.description: The polaroid is tilted by a random angle within plus or minus this, in degrees (DESIGN.md: 3).

vignetteFromPct.description: The photo filter’s vignette is clear out to this share of its radius (`vignetteRadiusPct`), then darkens to the end of it.

vignetteOpacityPct.description: How dark the vignette is at the end of its radius (ink), in %. With the mockup’s `vignetteRadiusPct` of 70 only the corners get that far: the middle of each side is at 71 % of the radius.

vignetteRadiusPct.description: The radius of the vignette, in % of the photo’s width across and of its height down, so it is an ellipse that follows the photo’s aspect (the mockup’s `#vig` gradient has 70). The middle of each side is `50 / vignetteRadiusPct` of the way out to the end of the radius and each corner `71 / vignetteRadiusPct`: with 70 only the corners reach the end, and a `vignetteFromPct` of 72 or more leaves the sides clear.

photo.description: The end photo (story 3.6): its canvas, its tilt and its filter. Real time and client only: the sim never reads it.

preRollMs.description: Sim ms played before the moment itself, so the build-up is seen (story 3.9). At least one step: the moment’s event is emitted by the step that ends at its `t`, so with less the replay would start after it.

postRollMs.description: Sim ms played after the moment, so its consequence is seen.

minSpacingMs.description: Sim ms between two retained moments: a closer one is dropped.

messyGag.description: Points of a gag that made a mess (`messyGagMinProps` props hit or broken).

waveLast.description: Points of the last response of a wave, whatever its quality.

points.description: What each kind of moment is worth (story 3.9, P7).

messyGagMinProps.description: Distinct props a gag must hit or break to count as a mess (P7: « bazar »).

messWindowMs.description: Sim ms after a gag in which a prop hit or broken counts for its mess.

frameWidthM.description: Width of the replay camera frame, in metres on the floor.

frameDepthM.description: Depth of the replay camera frame, in metres on the floor.

camera.description: The replay camera: the game camera’s angle, a tighter frame centred on the moment (story 3.9).

delayMs.description: Real ms between the last star and the first replayed moment.

endHoldMs.description: Real ms the last frame of a moment stays up, before the next one or the buttons.

replay.description: The highlight replay (story 3.9): which moments of the game are replayed, how, and with what pauses. Client only: the sim never reads it and `feel.json` is not touched, so no golden moves.

toonTones.description: The toon ramp, darkest to lightest, as 0-255 (ADR-008). Three reads it at `N.L x 0.5 + 0.5`, in equal bands.

default.description: The lights of any level that has no row of its own.

additionalProperties.description: A level's lights. The drawn linear colour is `material x (ambient + sun x tone) / pi`, so ambient + sun = pi with white lights draws a sun-facing surface as authored. The colour of each light multiplies its intensity.

byLevel.description: The lights of one level, by id. `npm run content:check` refuses an unknown level.

lights.description: The lights of each level (story 7.3, D7, D8).

sunOffsetM.description: Where the sun sits relative to the room centre, in metres: x, height, z.

widthM.description: How far the ink hull stands out of a silhouette, in metres of view space: constant on screen under the orthographic camera.

skipMaterials.description: The materials of a `.glb` that get no hull: thickening what is already ink would close the eyes.

outlines.description: The inverted-hull outlines of the characters and the props (story 7.3, D3, D4).

radiusM.description: Radius of the glow on a danger, in metres.

minOpacityPct.description: Opacity at the low of the pulse, in percent.

peakOpacityPct.description: Opacity at the top of the pulse, in percent; the steady one under reduced motion.

pulseHz.description: How fast the glow pulses, on the sim clock, in Hz. Nothing flashes above 3 Hz.

dangerTint.description: The reserved alert glow on the anchor of a telegraphed or open threat (story 7.3, D5).

decalWallHeightM.description: The colliders taller than this are the room's walls, no cover for the mess of a silence on the floor: its decal is moved off the furniture that hides it, never off the wall (story 3.15).

blobSkipColliderIds.description: The colliders with no blob shadow: the height rule cannot tell a stairwell from furniture.

render.description: The final look (story 7.3). Client-only: unlike `feel.json` it is not hashed into the journal, so no golden moves for it.

endHoldMs.description: When the level ends during the celebration, the photo and the Result wait for it at most this long, in real ms (story 7.4 D3).

collapseHoldMs.description: When Mama comes home early, the photo and the Result wait this long, in real ms, so that Papa's collapse plays (story 7.4 D14); 0 ends at once.

musicMuteMs.description: The level and sequence music are muted this long while the choir sings, in real ms.

stampMs.description: How long the finale's Epic stamp stays, in real ms (at most 900).

atMs.description: When the burst goes off, in real ms after the finale.

xPct.description: Where it goes off across the area the camera shows, in % of its width (50 = the middle).

zPct.description: Where it goes off along the area the camera shows, in % of its depth (50 = the middle).

heightM.description: How high above the floor it goes off, in metres.

sparks.description: Sparks in the burst; reduced motion keeps `REDUCED_MOTION_PARTICLE_KEEP_PCT` of them.

areaHalfM.description: Half the side of the square the bursts are placed in, in metres, around the floor point the camera looks at (a follow camera shows a part of a big room), cut to the room's floor.

speedMps.description: How fast a spark leaves its burst, in metres per second.

lifeMs.description: How long a spark lives, in real ms; it shrinks to nothing over that time.

sizeM.description: The size of a spark at birth, in metres.

colorTokens.description: The DESIGN.md colours of the sparks, taken in turn.

fireworks.description: The fireworks over the room (one pooled mesh, real time).

celebration.description: The level's finale (story 7.4): what the celebration module adds to the cue `finale_reached`. Client only and not hashed.

letterboxPct.description: Height of each letterbox bar at full blend, in % of the screen's height (at most 12: Papa and the exit stay clear).

rollDeg.description: Camera roll at full blend, in degrees; 0 under reduced motion.

vignetteOpacityPct.description: How dark the corners get at full blend, in % (ink).

titleHoldMs.description: How long the title card stays from the start of the sequence, in sim ms (at most 900); 0 shows none.

lightsFactor.description: The room's light intensities are multiplied by this at full blend.

ambientColor.description: The ambient light's colour at full blend (it is lerped from the level's).

sunColor.description: The sun's colour at full blend.

anyOf.description: A colour grade through the room's own lights: no post-processing (ADR-008).

grade.description: The colour grade, or null for none.

framingStyles.description: The film grammars of the special sequences (story 7.4 D8, D12), one row per id; a sequence's `framing.style` names its row. Client only and not hashed.

gainPct.description: Cue volume on its bus, in percent.

audio.description: The sound of a cue, played once.

layers.description: Extra sounds played at the same moment as `audio`, in order (the baby laughs on a perfect). A cue with layers needs an `audio`; a layer has no ring, vibration or cue of its own.

gainPct.description: Cue volume on its bus, in percent.

items.description: The sound of a cue, played once.

visual.description: The visual twin of the sound: a diegetic effect in the 3D world, or the UI element that fired the event.

kind.description: A ring on the floor that grows and fades.

anchor.description: Whose position the ring starts from. `threat` is the threat the event names; only for cues a threat def points at. `object` is the object the event names (`objectId`); only for cues a disruption or a house chore def points at. `door` is the level's `ANCHOR_door` (story 3.5), for a generic event.

maxRadiusM.description: Radius of the ring when it is gone, in metres.

durationMs.description: How long the ring takes to grow and fade, in sim ms.

pulses.description: Rings sent one after the other (2 or 3); absent means one ring.

pulseIntervalMs.description: Delay between the start of two pulses, in sim ms. Needs `pulses`, and the reverse.

oneOf.description: The visual twin of a sound.

kind.description: The UI element that fired the event is the visual twin (a stamped star): the director draws nothing. Only for a client event.

oneOf.description: The visual twin of a sound that a screen element already shows.

haptic.description: Vibration played with the cue, one of `haptics`.

flash.description: A screen flash, the mark of a perfect response. It also counts as a visual twin of the sound.

peakOpacityPct.description: Opacity of the flash at its start, in percent.

durationMs.description: How long the flash takes to fade out, in real ms. At most the 3 Hz interval, so a flash never restarts on itself.

fx.description: Plays the `feel.fx.<preset>` juice: shake, particles and, for `perfect`, the stamp; at the cue ring anchor.

additionalProperties.description: What the player hears, sees and feels for one signal. Every audio has a visual and a haptic.

cues.description: Every cue, by id. Threats will point at these ids.

events.description: Event name -> cue id. A sim event (`PapaBlocked`) or a client one (`CountdownTicked`); `npm run content:check` refuses any other name.

description: The multimodal feedback table (ADR-006): which event plays which sound, ring, vibration and camera effect.
